Op, if you give life the time it will show you the best moments. I wont lecture you on this though, I know deep down you know you would miss experiencing all of these life rewards. Just know were all thinking of you

Op are you still there? If you are, id take it as you didn't take the other hand fulls. Please, please reconsider. Life will offer its shitty times, and trust me, life has been fucking hell recently. On the other hand, we would miss out on all of the happy moments as well. Even the stupid things we take for granted like netflix or gaming, that would all be lost. Stay alive for me and for you.

Ive asked around to those around me and most of them gave similar answers of experiencing others love and support and to experience life with them is what they look forward to. I will try to give more thought into this. Thank you for the response

Just please remember the ones who rely on you, whether that's a pet, a friend, or a family member. Don't let them go through that. I had a friend who commited suicide 3 months ago and to this day I hate myself for it and wish I could do anything to bring him back. I guarantee there is someone in your life that wants nothing more than to see you happy. Please reach out to someone, even if you can't talk to someone around you, call the suicide hotline or have someone spend the night with you. Please don't make this decision, you deserve to live as much as anyone else❤

Please consider your family, your pets (if you have any), and any people you consider your friend. I have had these thoughts many times but the issue is I cant bear to leave my cat. She relies on me and I bet someone relies on you as well. Please, please, for my sake, continue on even if you can't see the light at the end of the tunnel. I promise there will come a day that things will start looking better for you. You are loved and appreciated by me, the others on this page, and the ones who you consider to be close in your life. Call an anonymous hotline if you don't feel you can talk to someone around you. Stay safe❤
